title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 28, 2026

A newly reported CME has Sunny checking in on the outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 28, 2026 at 14:36 UTC
💨 CME speed: 501 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)

📍 Source: N27W50 (western disk)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: Earth impact modeled — estimated arrival October 02, 2026 at 02:39 UTC; possible Kp 3–4

Sunny is on corona watch! 👀🌌
